resource.title: Stochastic Calculus（依据 J.-F. Le Gall 教材整理的讲义）— Russell Lyons, Indiana University
resource.covers: 印第安纳大学数学系 Russell Lyons 的公开讲义 PDF（约 3.4 MB，站点直接可下）。开篇目录显示结构为：Gaussian 变量与 Gaussian 过程、Gaussian 向量与 Gaussian 空间、鞅与滤过、Brown 运动、随机积分（Itô 积分）、随机微分方程等，按 Le Gall《Brownian Motion, Martingales, and Stochastic Calculus》的思路组织。对应节点的滤过、Itô 积分与 SDE 三条主线，属于 D4 级严格处理（含测度论前提）。

courses.prereq_text: Review of continuous martingale theory. Stochastic integration for continuous semimartingales. Existence and uniqueness theory for stochastic differential equations. Strong Markov property. Selected applications. Prerequisites: MATH 280A-B or consent of instructor.

courses.course: STAT 493 Stochastic Calculus for Option Pricing
courses.prereq_text: Introductory stochastic calculus mathematical foundation for pricing options and derivatives. Basic stochastic analysis tools, including stochastic integrals, stochastic differential equations, Ito's formula, theorems of Girsanov and Feynman-Kac, Black-Scholes option pricing, American and exotic options, bond options. Course overlaps with: CFRM 450. Prerequisite: a minimum grade of 2.0 in MATH 491/STAT 491.

notes: 两条原图前置各由一门课支撑：UCSD MATH 286 的唯一先修是 MATH 280A-B，而 MATH 280A 在同一目录页写的是「measure-theoretic foundations of probability theory」（即本节点的 M.1.6.1 测度论，顺带覆盖 M.6.1）；UW STAT 493 的先修 MATH 491/STAT 491 是「Random walks, Markov chains, branching processes, Poisson process, ... stationary processes」的随机过程课（M.6.3）。资源侧：Evans《An Introduction to Stochastic Differential Equations》原来的免费 PDF（math.berkeley.edu/~evans/SDE.course.pdf）现在 404，作者主页只剩勘误，故换成 Lyons 的讲义；该 PDF 本地 fetch 返回 200 但不解析文本，正文目录是通过抓取该 URL 得到的检索摘要核对的，未能逐页读正文。
